subject: Fix memory leak when loading slot migrations states fails (#658)
reason: The change only frees two robjs on an error branch in rdbLoadRioWithLoadingCtx: when a registered dynamic RDB aux-field decoder returns C_ERR. The sole registered decoder, clusterDecodeOpenSlotsAuxField (cluster-slot-states), runs only during a cluster full sync (RDBFLAGS_REPLICATION) and returns C_OK for all well-formed input. The matching encoder always produces well-formed records, so a real full sync never makes it return C_ERR; a truncated stream fails earlier in rdbLoadStringObject on a cleanup path this change does not touch.
